chapters.title: Your data fabric can't keep up
Feeding the data layer with Microsoft Fabric

takeaways: GPU performance is wasted when the data fabric cannot move data fast enough between storage, CPU and GPU memory.
NVIDIA Grace Blackwell with NVLink and Azure ND GB200 v6 orchestration removes interconnect bottlenecks and scales AI training and inference.
Once hardware is fast, ingestion pipelines and governance in Microsoft Fabric become the bottleneck and must be refactored.
hook: Your GPUs sit idle because the data fabric between storage, compute and analytics cannot keep up. This episode is for Azure architects and data leaders running AI workloads. Learn how NVIDIA Blackwell on Azure and a modernised Microsoft Fabric data layer remove I/O bottlenecks and cut training time and cost.
